I rewrote `message.md` in a calmer, shorter tone and didn't touch any other file:

> The export scheduled for 14:00 UTC is running late and will be ready by 16:00 UTC. Your existing data is unaffected, and we'll send you an email as soon as the export is ready.

All the facts are still there: it was scheduled for 14:00 UTC, it's delayed, it will be ready by 16:00 UTC, existing data is unaffected, and an email will go out when it's ready. I removed the all-caps line "THIS IS A DELAY, DO NOT PANIC." It didn't add any facts, and the calmer wording now does the job of reassuring readers.
